description.value: You know how to pitch a camp that doesn't glow on a Geiger counter by morning. When you Camp in irradiated or otherwise hazardous terrain, you and everyone relying on your preparations take a -2 circumstance penalty to any exposure-based hazard that terrain would normally inflict overnight.

cinderfall.incomplete: The -2 penalty to an overnight exposure hazard is gated on 'irradiated or otherwise hazardous terrain', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one. and hazard severity isn't exposed to a predicate regardless.
